description:
draft-ietf-jmap-filenode-13 §3.2.4 references the standard Foo/copy semantics from RFC 8620 §5.4: each create entry is a 'copy of the source object with the given properties overridden'. The spec example at lines 643+ shows arbitrary FileNode property keys in the create map (name, parentId, type, role, shareWith, etc.).

The current src/filenode.rs:814-825 only applies parentId and name from obj_val onto source_node; all other override fields supplied by the client (type, role, shareWith, blobId override) are silently discarded.

Trigger: client sends FileNode/copy create: { 'c1': { 'id': 'src1', 'name': 'copy', 'role': 'archive' } }. Bad behavior: the role override is dropped and the copy retains the source node's role.

Required: deserialize obj_val as a PatchObject (or as FileNode with all-optional fields), and merge over source_node before serializing back. The handler must mirror the behavior of FileNode/set update — apply every supplied field as an override.
title: handle_filenode_copy only applies parentId and name overrides; spec allows arbitrary property overrides
